Unfortunately, the injection site has remained painful with a hard, clot-like swelling even after two weeks (as of 16th July). We initially assumed it would settle in a couple of days, but the issue persists.

Now, the doctor is asking for a second consultation fee just to check on this complication — which, in our view, may have resulted from the rushed injection during the first visit. Follow-up for such a case should be part of the doctor’s responsibility, not treated as a new charge.

Overall, not a recommended experience. A more careful and patient approach was expected, especially for home visits.
